program_plain: World: 400 slightly elongated particles (ellipse half-axes 0.55 and 0.65) in a periodic 2D box at density 0.87 (lattice spacing about 1.15). Rules, overdamped Brownian dynamics at temperature T: (1) each pair interacts through an orientation-dependent Lennard-Jones potential of strength e_p (repulsive core, weak attraction, depending on both particles' orientations, which can rotate); (2) each pair also feels a non-conservative force with Lennard-Jones magnitude and strength e_a, directed perpendicular to the line joining them, always in the same rotational sense; (3) thermal noise acts on positions and orientations, orientations relaxing faster. Set e_a/e_p = 33 and T = 6 and run for 30 time units; measure six-fold bond order and defect counts.

THE RULE SYSTEM (plain words):
World: 400 slightly elongated particles (ellipse half-axes 0.55 and 0.65) in a periodic 2D box at density 0.87 (lattice spacing about 1.15). Rules, overdamped Brownian dynamics at temperature T: (1) each pair interacts through an orientation-dependent Lennard-Jones potential of strength e_p (repulsive core, weak attraction, depending on both particles' orientations, which can rotate); (2) each pair also feels a non-conservative force with Lennard-Jones magnitude and strength e_a, directed perpendicular to the line joining them, always in the same rotational sense; (3) thermal noise acts on positions and orientations, orientations relaxing faster. Set e_a/e_p = 33 and T = 6 and run for 30 time units; measure six-fold bond order and defect counts.

OTHER RULE SYSTEMS IN THE SAME BEHAVIOUR CLASS (parameter variants):
  (none distinct)
